name: Nettles
overview: Scripture portrays nettles as an obnoxious and undesirable plant often associated with desolation and judgment. In passages like Proverbs 24:31 and Isaiah 34:13, nettles grow over broken walls and fortresses, symbolizing ruin and abandonment. Figuratively, as seen in Hosea 9:6 and Zephaniah 2:9, nettles represent the consequences of divine judgment where once-pleasant places become overrun and inhospitable, emphasizing God’s sovereign hand in bringing desolation upon the unrepentant.
